A '''government archive''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. A report prepared in an effort to reduce colonization in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was stored in archive and detailed five [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] backed attacks on worlds beyond the frontier at the time; the [[Assault on Lexrul|assault]] on [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]], the [[Assault on Hathrox|assault]] on [[Hathrox III|Hathrox]], the [[Assault on Drogheda|assault]] on [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]], the [[Assault on Imram|assault]] on [[Imram]] and the [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|assault]] on [[Parcovey Minor]]. The archive and the records were found in a fragmentary state in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], and the Academician of Popular Studies, [[Thunys Albegron]] spoke concerning them at the [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The archive was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
